title: AtariBench measures spatiotemporal errors in vision-language model gameplay
summary: The benchmark directly compares objectively logged behavioral stagnation when the history format changes. The benchmark does not establish performance on other games, interfaces or real-world tasks.
ai_technology: Vision-language models were evaluated on Atari gameplay with logged actions and game states; behavior was compared across history formats.
organization: University of California San Diego; Google DeepMind; Peking University
